rules.key_value: Broker fee paid only by the party who hired the broker
rules.title: Broker fees paid only by the party who hired the broker
rules.requirement: A rental broker's fee can only be charged to the person who hired the broker. If the landlord hired the broker, the landlord pays the fee, not you.
rules.requirement_es: La comisión de un corredor de alquileres solo se puede cobrar a la persona que contrató al corredor. Si el propietario contrató al corredor, el propietario paga la comisión, no usted.
rules.coverage_text: Fees charged by licensed brokers or salespersons for finding rental housing.
rules.quote: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.
